# apicurio_artifact_version (Data Source)

Looks up one version of an artifact by id or by version expression. Fails when it does not exist. The content of a `DISABLED` version is not served by the registry and is null.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# One version by id.
data "apicurio_artifact_version" "v1" {
  group_id    = "payments"
  artifact_id = "price"
  version     = "1.0.0"
}

# The tip of a branch (default: branch=latest, the newest enabled version),
# with referenced schemas inlined.
data "apicurio_artifact_version" "stable" {
  group_id            = "payments"
  artifact_id         = "price"
  version             = "branch=stable"
  references_handling = "DEREFERENCE"
}

output "stable_schema" {
  value = data.apicurio_artifact_version.stable.content
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `artifact_id` (String) Artifact id.
- `group_id` (String) Group of the artifact.

### Optional

- `references_handling` (String) How references are rendered in `content`: `PRESERVE` (default, as stored), `DEREFERENCE` (referenced content inlined) or `REWRITE` (reference URLs rewritten to the registry).
- `version` (String) A version id, or `branch=<branch_id>` for the tip of a branch. Defaults to `branch=latest`, the newest version that is neither a draft nor disabled.

### Read-Only

- `artifact_type` (String) Type of the artifact.
- `content` (String) Content, rendered per `references_handling`.
- `content_id` (Number) Content id.
- `content_type` (String) Media type of the content.
- `created_on` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Description.
- `global_id` (Number) Global id.
- `id` (String) `group_id/artifact_id/<resolved version>`.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels.
- `modified_by` (String) User of the last modification.
- `modified_on` (String) Last modification time (RFC 3339).
- `name` (String) Name.
- `owner` (String) Owner.
- `references` (Attributes List) References of the version. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--references))
- `resolved_version` (String) The version id the lookup resolved to.
- `state` (String) State of the version.

<a id="nestedatt--references"></a>
### Nested Schema for `references`

Read-Only:

- `artifact_id` (String)
- `group_id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `version` (String)
